{{Short description|South Korean statistician}}
'''Byeong Uk Park '''is a South Korean statistician working in structured nonparametric regression, semiparametric inference and non-Euclidean data analysis. He is Distinguished Professor at the [[Seoul National University]].

Park received his PhD from the [[University of California, Berkeley|University of California at Berkeley]] in 1987 working with [[Peter J. Bickel|Peter Bickel]]. He is a Fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=ASA Fellows List|url=https://www.amstat.org/ASA/Your-Career/Awards/ASA-Fellows-list.aspx|access-date=2021-02-25|website=www.amstat.org|archive-date=2019-04-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190425013824/https://www.amstat.org/ASA/Your-Career/Awards/ASA-Fellows-list.aspx|url-status=dead}}</ref> the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]<ref>{{Cite news|title=New IMS Fellows 2005: Congratulations to you all!|work=IMS Bulletin|url=https://imstat.org/wp-content/uploads/Bulletin34_8.pdf}}</ref> and the [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]], and an Elected Member of the [[International Statistical Institute]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=ISI Elected Members - ISI|url=https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/members/indivual/isi-elected-members|access-date=2021-02-25|website=www.isi-web.org}}</ref> He has received the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] Carver Medal<ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} 2018 Carver Award Winner Announced|url=https://imstat.org/2018/05/06/2018-carver-award-winner-announced/|access-date=2021-02-25|language=en}}</ref> in 2018 and, as the first statistician, the Inchon Memorial Foundation Inchon Award in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} South Korean Inchon Award for Byeong Park|url=https://imstat.org/2019/11/15/south-korean-inchon-award-for-byeong-park/|access-date=2021-02-25|language=en}}</ref>
Park was the Laplace Lecturer<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bernoulli Society for Mathematical Statistics and Probability {{!}} Named Lectures at the 9th World Congress of Probability and Statistics|url=https://bernoullisociety.org/15-features/231-named-lectures-for-the-9th-world-congress-of-probability-and-statistics}}</ref> at the 9th World Congress in Probability and Statistics in 2016 in Toronto. He was also an [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers#2018, Rio de Janeiro|invited speaker]] at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2018 in [[Rio de Janeiro]].

Park was the President of the Korean Statistical Society 2021–2022, a Vice-President of the [[International Statistical Institute]] 2019–2023, and served as Scientific Secretary of the [[Bernoulli Society for Mathematical Statistics and Probability|Bernoulli Society]] 2015-19. He was a Co-Editor of Computational Statistics and Data Analysis 2016-2025. He has published over 170 scientific articles in refereed journals.
